tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Day is the website's white page; Night is the brand's deep navy for print, signage and after-dark pages.

tokens.name: surface-wash
tokens.usage: Quiet bands that sit inside the page: Selected work, the menu panel.

tokens.name: surface-dark
tokens.usage: The one dark band on a light page (How we work). Use once per page.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface and surface-wash. 21:1 by day, 13.9:1 by night.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: the grey half of a headline, captions, locations. 4.65:1 on surface-wash by day, 7.1:1 by night.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines between list rows, card tops and filter groups. Always 1px.

tokens.name: on-dark
tokens.usage: Text on surface-dark and over photography.

tokens.name: on-dark-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on surface-dark (7.8:1 by day, 5.9:1 by night).

tokens.name: lamp
tokens.usage: Light itself: lit areas in icons and drawings, the lit half of the moon, the active marker. Sampled from the moon on the brand board. Never text on day surfaces (2.0:1); on navy it reads at 8.6:1.

tokens.name: lamp-glow
tokens.usage: Glow and highlights on dark grounds: beam lines in concept drawings, the status dot in the header.

tokens.name: brand-navy
tokens.usage: After the sun. The brand's ground on the board, business cards and signage.

tokens.name: brand-navy-deep
tokens.usage: The darkest navy; icon ink and the night surface.

tokens.name: brand-cream
tokens.usage: The wordmark on navy. Text colour on brand-navy (12.5:1).

tokens.name: brand-paper
tokens.usage: Print stock and warm light pages. Pair with brand-navy-deep text (15.5:1).

tokens.name: brand-stone
tokens.usage: Secondary print fields and mount boards.

tokens.name: field-navy
tokens.usage: Large brand fields that must stay visible on either ground (the cover slab, a full-bleed brand panel).

styles.name: brand-xl
styles.usage: The tagline at full size: covers, signage, the first page of a proposal.

styles.name: brand-line
styles.usage: Brand lines inside a page or a print spread. One per page.

styles.name: brand-italic
styles.usage: Section names in print (Draw, Refine, Realise). Not for the website's UI.

styles.name: statement
styles.usage: The oversized indented statement. First line indented one column; lead phrase in ink, the rest in ink-muted. Phones: 28 to 40px.

styles.name: h1
styles.sample: Light, drawn before it is built.
styles.usage: Hero headline over photography, in on-dark with the second sentence in on-dark-muted. Phones: 34px.

styles.name: h2
styles.sample: From first sketch to final focus.
styles.usage: Section headings. Two-tone like h1 when the heading runs on.

styles.name: h3
styles.sample: We light the places people gather.
styles.usage: Smaller section openers.

styles.name: h4
styles.sample: We light the dark as carefully as the light.
styles.usage: Quotes and principles, banner lines over images.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: From the first concept sketch to the night we focus the last fitting.
styles.usage: Intro lines, step titles, list rows.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Sections through every slot, cove and niche, coordinated with your drawings.
styles.usage: Running text, buttons, nav.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Locations, form help, legal. Never below 14px for sentences.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Technical captions, uppercase: fitting ref, colour temperature, beam, dim level.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Card meta and outlined tags, uppercase. Short words only.

styles.name: geist-thin
styles.usage: Specimen. Not used on the site.

styles.name: geist-extralight
styles.usage: Specimen. Not used on the site.

styles.name: geist-light
styles.usage: Large numerals over photography only.

styles.name: geist-regular
styles.usage: The house weight: every heading and all running text.

styles.name: geist-medium
styles.usage: The logo lockup subline and rare emphasis.

styles.name: geist-semibold
styles.usage: Specimen. Avoid; Vellum emphasises with tone, not weight.

styles.name: geist-bold
styles.usage: Specimen. Avoid.

styles.name: geist-extrabold
styles.usage: Specimen. Avoid.

styles.name: geist-black
styles.usage: Specimen. Avoid.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Icon to label, meta items.

tokens.name: space-s
tokens.usage: Tight stacks: name over role.

tokens.name: space-m
tokens.usage: Card meta gap, form field gap.

tokens.name: space-l
tokens.usage: Phone minimum gutter, caption offset.

tokens.name: gutter-phone
tokens.usage: Page gutter and column gap under 700px.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Page gutter and column gap on desktop. The site's base unit.

tokens.name: block-s
tokens.usage: Section top padding.

tokens.name: block-m
tokens.usage: Gap between a heading and its content block; row gap between project cards.

tokens.name: block-l
tokens.usage: Gap before a list group; bottom of a section.

tokens.name: block-xl
tokens.usage: Statement and quote breathing room on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Photography, bands, the hero. The default.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Project image tiles and thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-tag
tokens.usage: Outlined mono tags.

tokens.name: radius-button
tokens.usage: Buttons and icon buttons.

tokens.name: bar-height
tokens.usage: The header bar that docks to the top (52px on phones).

tokens.name: logo-bar
tokens.usage: Logo width in the header bar.

tokens.name: logo-hero
tokens.usage: Logo width over the hero image (132px minimum).

tokens.name: logo-min
tokens.usage: Smallest the wordmark may appear on screen.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Icon grid; draw at 1.5px stroke.
